Mills, Dams and Certain Other Works on Watercourses

law.catch_line: Rights of applicant on payment of damages
law.text: The applicant, to whom any such leave is granted, shall, upon paying to the several parties entitled thereto the compensation so ascertained, become seized in fee simple of the land circumscribed by the commissioners, and be authorized to proceed according to such leave.
